Profile

I work as an agentic engineer on full stack design, algorithms, and mathematical proofs and formalizations. At SoundImports I am the project owner of Acqui, our in-house purchasing and data analysis tool. Outside work, I co-authored a set theory preprint and orchestrated its full formalization in Lean. I like creating and solving competitive programming puzzles. Besides that, I play Magic: The Gathering and squash, go bouldering, and like hiking.
